program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((a (normalize-cells (obj-cells (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0))))))
         (b (normalize-cells (obj-cells (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0))))))
         (cells (cond [(not (empty? (find-color g 3))) (filter (lambda (p) (member? p b)) a)]
                      [(not (empty? (find-color g 4))) (remove-duplicates (append a b))]
                      [else (append (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p b))) a)
                                    (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p a))) b))])))
    (if (empty? cells)
        (empty-grid 1 1 0)
        (let* ((norm (normalize-cells cells))
               (h (+ 1 (apply max (map first norm))))
               (w (+ 1 (apply max (map second norm)))))
          (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) (if (member? (list r c) norm) 8 0)))))))
